features.label: Core Features
features.heading: Built for professionals who take privacy seriously
features.f1_desc: Instantly surface the right file across thousands of documents. Natural language queries understand context, not just filenames.
features.f2_desc: Run powerful LLMs directly on your machine. Extract entities, summarize clauses, and generate reports — no data ever leaves your device.
features.f3_desc: Every file is encrypted at rest with AES-256. Your client data, case files, and financial records are locked down by default.

showcase.label: Why Filenest
showcase.heading: Your practice deserves better tools.
showcase.s1_body: Your clients send dozens of files — passports, permits, leases, letters. Finding the right one means opening folder after folder. Filenest reads every document and surfaces exactly what you need in under 2 seconds.
showcase.s2_headline: You want AI. Not a data breach.
showcase.s2_body: ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude — useful, but uploading a client's passport or medical record to a cloud service is a liability you can't afford. Filenest runs AI entirely on your machine. Nothing leaves. Ever.
showcase.s3_body: Name, date, permit number, expiry — you've typed it all by hand a hundred times. Filenest reads the document and pulls every field automatically. You review, you approve. Done.
showcase.s4_body: "When does James's permit expire?" Instead of opening five documents to find one answer, ask Filenest. It reads your files locally and answers immediately — with the source cited.
showcase.s5_body: Immigration consultant, lawyer, accountant, real estate agent — Filenest ships with templates tailored to your workflow. The right required documents, the right fields, ready from day one.
